# DGP — Decision Graph Protocol

> An MIT-licensed Numerous ApS protocol for decision-based AI agents, typed assessments,
> immutable evidence frames, and application-guarded actions. Jev-first, assessor-neutral.

Company website: https://numerous.com
Canonical repository: https://github.com/numerous-com/dgp
Core version: experimental DGP 0.1. Maintainer/copyright: Numerous ApS.
DGP is independent of TypeSafe AI; Jev is a supported assessor, not the protocol.

## Attribution and limits
- [MIT license](https://github.com/numerous-com/dgp/blob/main/LICENSE)
- [Citation metadata](https://github.com/numerous-com/dgp/blob/main/CITATION.cff)
ThreadDesk is a local reference demo with simulated effects. Added batch/coding
profiles are contracts with selected tests, not implemented production servers.
No performance, production-readiness, or model-quality superiority is established.
